In Locus, players compete to earn the most points by filling in their scoresheet.

Every turn, players choose a colored shape to draw on their scoresheet. There are five colored areas that score in different ways. Choose carefully to not block yourself and collect as many bonuses as possible to rack up the most points.

Gameplay is language independent.

—description from the designer
author: Stan van Rooijen

input.title: Paper World
input.description:
In Paper World, each player takes on the role of a traveler trying to recreate the landscapes they have seen during their journeys using layers of paper. Stack the various layers of paper you find to have the most victory
points at the end of the game.

On your turn, you can either:
TAKE one or more cards.
PLACE one or more cards in front of you, forming your landscape.
In both cases, the rule is the same: take / place cards of the same color or the same value.

When only 2 piles of cards remain in the center at the end of a player’s turn, the end game is triggered. Each player, including the one who triggered the end of the game, plays one more turn before the final scoring.

The player with the most stars on the cards wins. In case of a tie, the player with the fewest cards in their discard pile wins.
author: Alexandre Aguilar
Benoit Turpin

input.title: Unlock!: Short Adventures – Inside the Mind of Sherlock Holmes
input.description:
Unlock!: Short Adventures - Inside the Mind of Sherlock Holmes! Sherlock Holmes and his faithful companion Watson are watching a show of entertainers in Covent Garden, when suddenly, a fire-eater named Amara drops dead!

Unlock Short Adventures are 30 to 45 minute Unlocks in a small format, ideal for pocketing or giving as a gift. Unlock! is a cooperative card game inspired by escape rooms. Unlock! brings these experiences into your home, around a table. After familiarizing yourself with the context of the scenario, you begin your adventure in a room (a location map showing various numbers). Search the room for objects! Beware: some may be hidden! Visual and audio puzzles slow your progress. It's up to you to cooperate with your partners to advance and finish on time.

To play, you need the free Unlock! app, compatible with Android and iOS phones and tablets. It allows you to obtain clues, locate hidden objects and enter the codes you discover. The app makes the game very real. It adds to the atmosphere, with music dedicated to each adventure, audio puzzles, terrible penalties and a fatal countdown.

Unlock!: Short Adventures - Inside the Mind of Sherlock Holmes is a scenario of difficulty 2 out of 3.
author: Cyril Demaegd
Dave Neale

alternateNames: Unlock! Короткі пригоди. У голові Шерлока Голмса
Unlock!: Miniaventuras – En la cabeza de Sherlock Holmes
Unlock!: Rövid kalandok – Sherlock Holmes elméjében
Unlock!: Short – Nella Mente di Sherlock Holmes
Unlock!: Short Adventures – Dans la tête de Sherlock Holmes
Unlock!: Short Adventures – Im Kopf von Sherlock Holmes

input.title: Das Hochbeet von Schalottenburg
input.description:
Loud fanfares ring out through the quiet town of Schalottenburg! Vegetable athletes from all different backgrounds parade through the streets with their flags. That can only mean one thing: The annual vegetable competition is upon us! All of Schalottenburg's citizens quickly gather to cheer on their teams as they compete against each other in the earthy raised vegetable bed arena. Of course, there will be a lot of pushing and shoving again, with the aim of creating the largest possible formation of the same types of vegetables. Whoever succeeds best will lift the coveted trophy into the night sky of Schalottenburg!

Gameplay:
Take the tile in front of you and push it into the raised vegetable bed from the outside, with the vegetable side facing upwards. Then place one of your wooden markers on this tile. Take the piece you pushed out and keep it for your next turn. Continue playing until everyone has placed their last wooden marker (2 or 3 pieces). 
At the end of each round mark as many fields on your scoring boards as the number of tiles with the same type of vegetable that are directly connected to each other vertically or horizontally.

Game end:
The game ends as soon as there are only 3 or fewer face-down vegetable tiles left in the raised vegetable bed. Finish the current round and then add up the points of all the vegetable teams on your scoreboards. The winner is the player with the highest score.
author: Dirk Barsuhn

input.title: Burning Cookies
input.description:
In Burning galletitas ("Burning cookies") you will compete in an international amateur baking contest in search of the world's best homemade cookie recipe, but... watch out!

Someone may be boycotting one of your secret ingredients or turning up the oven temperature while you're not looking so  your delicious cookies will be burned to a crisp and you won't win the contest

Add a cookie to the tray. And then another, and another... The color must always be different and the number higher than the previous one. But you can also play hidden cards and special tricks. If you fail, you will take the burned cookies home and you will have to buy snacks for everybody.

—description from the publisher (translated)

En Burning galletitas participarás en un concurso internacional de repostería amateur en busca de la mejor receta de galletas caseras del mundo pero... ¡cuidado!

Alguien puede estar boicoteando alguno de tus ingredientes secretos o subiendo la temperatura del horno mientras no miras para que tus deliciosas galletitas se chamusquen y no puedas ganar el concurso.

Añade una galletita a la bandeja. Y luego otra, y otra... El color tiene que ser siempre diferente y el número superior a la anterior. Aunque también puedes jugar cartas ocultas y trucos especiales. Si fallas, te llevas las galletitas quemadas a casa y tendrás que pagar la merienda

—description from the publisher
author: Pablo Jiménez
Helena Lobo

input.title: Tag Team
input.description:
Inspired by classic arcade-fighting games, Tag Team is an auto battler combined with a deck-building game. Make your team of two fighters from the twelve available — each with their own techniques and special moves — and build an unbeatable synergy by combining their two unique decks!

In more detail, you start with a deck of only two cards, and the fight unfolds automatically: Flip your cards one at a time and apply their effects. At the end of each round, you get to turn up the heat on the opposing team by strategically adding new cards to program your deck — but without reordering the cards already present. Determine what makes your tag team tick, play devastating combos, and dominate your opponent by deftly blocking their attacks. Timing is everything if you want to emerge victorious and knock out your foe!

AWARDS -
2026 - Dice Tower - Best 2-Player Game
2025 - Best of Gen Con 2025
author: Gricha German
Corentin Lebrat

input.title: Sly Mole
input.description:
A whole family of moles has made the farm their home! The new neighbors prefer to live underground, so their eyesight is far from perfect. During their excursions topside they sometimes visit the garden patch and unwittingly snatch a vegetable... or two.

Finding the mole responsible is not an easy task! But luckily the hardworking bumblebee is always somewhere nearby collecting pollen. If anyone can help, it’s him! However, even though he can tell you some of the details, it’s up to you to solve the case!

—description from the publisher
author: Alexander Peshkov
Ekaterina Pluzhnikova

input.title: Mooki Island
input.description:
Set off on an adventure to meet the most adorable creatures: Mookies!

Mooki Island is a quick, engaging game  in which you’ll collect as many Mookies from each family as possible to win Trophies! Can you get the shiny Legendary Mookie cards? And above all: Watch out for that strange-looking Spider who’s just waiting to play a trick on you!

The game’s simple rules (each player takes a card and places it in front of themselves) helps younger players discover how a majority collection game works. As they play and play again, they’ll gradually become shrewd little strategists, ready to surprise their parents!

But that’s not all! After every game, go explore the island together with your poster, and name the Mookies you befriended. Lumilion, Dracoleaf, all names are good!

AWARDS -
- Best Kids Game, 2026 As d’Or
- Kinderspiel des Jahres 2026 Winner


—description from the publisher
author: Florian Sirieix

input.title: Average Joe
input.description:
In an age where everyone strives to be extraordinary, we have forgotten how good it is to just be, well.... average. Enter our new game Average Joe, a riveting card game which is all about “playing it safe”, where being too right or too wrong can cost you the game... Combining the fascinating world of statistics with strategic guesswork, Average Joe is not about standing out, instead players must strike the perfect balance and stay in the middle ground to secure victory!

—description from the publisher
author: Matt Edmondson

input.title: The Hobbit: There & Back Again
input.description:
The Hobbit: There & Back Again is a competitive adventure game in which players draft dice to make pathways, collect resources, and perform actions that help them to reach their chapter goal.

In more detail, each of the players has their own adventure board book open to the same chapter of the game, and they play in turn order starting with the shortest player. That player rolls all of the dice, then selects one, then the next player selects one, and so on until all dice have been chosen, at which point the next player rolls all the dice once again.

With your chosen dice, you use a dry-erase pen to mark the current chapter of your book, drafting a path to evade trolls, battle goblins, solve riddles, and pen the best conclusion to each chapter. The game takes players through the eight most iconic challenges faced by Bilbo and the Dwarves in The Hobbit, such as overcoming trolls, goblins, wargs, and giant spiders; reclaiming the treasure of the dwarves; and defeating the dragon Smaug. In the end, you want to complete the most rewarding journey to The Lonely Mountain.

The Hobbit: There & Back Again includes a solo mode, as well as a way to increase the game's difficulty, whether for some players to balance different skills levels or for everyone to increase the challenge.
author: Reiner Knizia

alternateNames: Le Hobbit: Histoire d'un Aller et Retour
El Hobbit: Historia de una Ida y de una Vuelta
Lo Hobbit: La Riconquista del Tesoro
Hobit: Cesta tam a zase zpátky

input.title: The Lord of the Rings: Fate of the Fellowship
input.description:
As members of The Fellowship and the allies who rise to aid them, you must embark on a journey that may either save or doom Middle-earth. Navigate a world beset by shadow, where every choice forges a new path. The threads of destiny weave together, and the fate of The Free Peoples lies in your valor, friendship, and resolve. Will the One Ring be cast into the fire, or will the bearer be lost to despair?

The Lord of the Rings: Fate of the Fellowship is a co-operative game in which each player controls two characters, lending their unique abilities to protect Frodo, battle enemies in pivotal locations, and evade the menacing Nazgûl and Sauron's searching Eye.

Each playthrough presents new challenges with 24 different objectives, 14 events, and 13 playable characters. The game is won if the group destroys the One Ring before Frodo loses all hope.

A solo adventure is included.

—description from the publisher
author: Matt Leacock

alternateNames: A Gyűrűk Ura: A Szövetség útja
Der Herr der Ringe: Das Schicksal der Gemeinschaft
Le Seigneur des Anneaux: Le Destin de la Communauté
O Senhor dos Anéis: Sina da Sociedade
El Señor de los Anillos: El Destino de la Comunidad
Il Signore degli Anelli: Il Destino della Compagnia

input.title: Flower Shower
input.description:
In Volle Kanne!, each player wants to water the plants in their personal garden as well as possible.

Each player has a water die that they roll each turn, with a separate die being passed from player to player so that someone always rolls two dice on a turn.

Most flowers on your garden sheet want a precise amount of water, and you score should you succeed, whereas the lucky clover will take as much water as you give it and the cacti wants as little water as possible. Complete all the requirements in a particular area to gain bonuses.

Two different garden sheets are included.
author: Sven M. Kübler

input.title: Taco Loco
input.description:
In Taco Loco, you want to stuff others as full of tacos as possible.

Each player has a hand of three cards, and on a turn you add one of your fillings to a taco in play, keeping all of the cards visible. If the taco now sums exactly 11, give this taco to another player, who sets it aside. If the sum is less than 11, nothing happens, and if the sum is higher than 11, you've overfilled the taco and ruined it; take the cards yourself, and set them aside. If you wish to play a card of the same value as the most recently played card in a taco, set this card aside to form the base of a new taco.

The game includes two special cards: the "legendary taco" card immediately fills the taco to 11, allowing you to give these cards to someone else, whereas the "lonesome taco" allows you to bring the sum of a taco to 0 or to respond to someone playing a legendary taco, forcing them to take it.

When all the cards have been played, the game ends, and whoever has the fewest cards wins.
author: Treo Game Designers

input.title: Happy Mochi
input.description:
Be the first to empty your hand!

In Happy Mochi, all cards must be played in pairs, and you can never rearrange your hand.

To play, you must follow value restrictions — unless you have two matching cards! In that case, shout "Happy Mochi!" and break all the rules!

Special abilities and color-matching add an extra layer to this strategic party game, where luck and tactics go hand in hand.

—description from the publisher
author: Johan Benvenuto
Romaric Galonnier

input.title: Buzzin' Picnic
input.description:
Imagine yourself enjoying a warm afternoon in a flower field, watching friendly insects going about their day and having a lovely time with your family and friends. That is until the annoying bugs ruin your peaceful picnic by buzzing around, crawling all over your food and making you regret ever going out. But will that stop you?

Welcome to Buzzin’ Picnic. In the game, you and your friends are out on a picnic, taking turns guiding Friendly Insects to Insect Hotels while keeping your food safe from Annoying Bugs.

As you play, earn points for every Annoying Bug card that you slap with a Slipper. Plant Flowers to attract Friendly Insects from other players' Flower Fields, and win the game by earning the most points and filling your Points Pile with Friendly Insect and Annoying Bug cards.

Of course, it wouldn‘t be much fun if things were that simple! To make things more interesting, we came up with a few clever ways for you to mess with your friends and loved ones!

—description from the publisher
author: Helmanas Lik
Indrė Lik

input.title: Sanctuary
input.description:
In Sanctuary, you will plan and design a modern, scientifically-managed zoo for animals and visitors. A supply of 135 unique zoo tiles provides you with animals, buildings, and projects. In every game, you want to find the best mix from those available to build the most successful zoological establishment. Different effects on the tiles will help you to achieve conservation goals and to increase the attraction of your zoo.

Each player has a set of four action cards to manage their gameplay, and the power of an action is determined by the slot the card currently occupies. One of those cards will let you play projects, and the other three cards will let you play animals of a specific habitat: forest, rock, or water.

Sanctuary is based on its predecessor Ark Nova, but modifies and simplifies many of the mechanisms of that game in an elegant and surprising manner. Your goal to find the best way to puzzle together your animals, buildings, and projects on your zoo map is an ongoing pleasure!

—description from the publisher
author: Mathias Wigge

alternateNames: Ark Nova: Il Santuario degli Animali
アーク　ノヴァ　サンクチュアリ

input.title: Wispwood
input.description:
Is that a light at the end of the… branch?

A curious cat prowls into the forest, lured by flickering lights of all colors dancing through the trees. What are they? Oh, the wisps from the old tales! Each one sparkles with charm and mischief, carrying a unique personality. Can you guide them just right and make your forest the brightest?

Welcome to Wispwood, a magical place populated by glowing wisps. On your turn, choose a wisp tile and a shape to place in your personal grid — your very own growing forest. Each wisp has desires about where it wants to shine, and even the magical trees have preferences! You'll aim to meet their expectations across three scoring rounds. Between rounds, the forest shifts — fading and expanding — yet the wisps you've already placed remain, shaping the possibilities ahead.

With each game, new goal cards redefine the wisps' whims, ensuring your forest grows in a unique way every time. Enter the forest and explore the magic of Wispwood!

—description from the publisher
author: Reed Ambrose

input.title: Wildblooms
input.description:
In the tactical game Wildwuchs, you want to make the colorful wildflower meadow bloom, ideally with several flowers at once because as many as possible should flourish here.

Clever decisions are required in this interactive gaming experience that features short waiting times and special combo effects. Whoever has the largest wildflower meadow blooming at the end wins — and as a special treat for nature fans, you'll have your own 3D wildflower meadow!
author: Kasper Lapp

input.title: Nocturnis
input.description:
In this peaceful flip-and-write game, players aim to lure different kinds of moths into their garden. Whoever manages to meet the delicate needs of each moth species and creates the most diverse habitat will score the most points and win the game.

Players earn victory points by marking squares on their garden sheet and playing moth cards from their hand. Each moth requires a unique habitat: a combination of conditions, represented by symbols on a grid. Each round, a card with a shape is drawn from the deck. To play a moth card and score the indicated victory points (and sometimes bonus actions), players have to mark this shape in such a way that the corresponding symbols are within it. Larger moths can only be played by first collecting both wing cards. Bonus points are awarded for diversity, while overpopulation of a single kind of moth is to be avoided.

—description from the publisher
author: Maxine Metzger

input.title: Guildlands
input.description:
In the world of Dragoria, the realm of Thornshire lies in chaos. A horde of ancient dragons have devastated the land, reducing cities and towns to smouldering ruins. Survivors have retreated into caves, waiting for the chance to rebuild their lives. Thornshire’s Queen has issued a royal decree: the Guilds must restore the realm and surpass its former glory. The capital city of Ferrum’s Ford will rise again, shaped by the finest craftspeople of the Royal Guilds: Road Toll Collectors, Merchants, Gardeners, Wizards, Druids and the City Watch.

Each Guild brings unique expertise to honour the past and forge the future. Amid this noble mission, rivalries simmer. Tempted by power and wealth, the Guilds vie for dominance as they shape the city’s future.

Will the scorched lands thrive again? Will Ferrum’s Ford rise to unmatched splendour? Which Guild will win the Queen’s favour and claim ultimate victory?

Tile Actions: On your turn, you MUST perform one of two tile actions. The first action is to choose to take and add a new tile to the board. You may select to take a tile from the pool or risk taking the face-down tile from the top of the stack. The second action you may choose would be to rotate a tile on the City's edge to a more self-rewarding configuration. Be warned...your opponents are watching your every move.

Special Actions: Once per turn you may perform a special action. Special actions allow you place your workers on the board or use your Guilds unique abilities. Choose wisely how you use these abilities as they are limited. 
 OF COURSE THERE'S MONEY INVOLVED!!! You can obtain an additional tile or special action on your turn but there is a cost! Is the reward greater for the investment or the bonus points at the end of the game for unspent gold?

Guild Boards: The Guild Boards detail each Guild's unique abilities as well as their goal in claiming the Queen's favor! Study all the boards carefully as each is specific to its own Guild.

—description from the publisher
author: Ken Boyter
Kedric Winks

input.title: DONE I AM
input.description:
DONE I AM is an especially silly game. If you take it seriously, then it’s your own fault!
The game consists of a handful of cards. Theoretically, there are 83 cards. But because curious things happen in this game, there may be fewer. However, it doesn’t matter. On your turn, you may either draw 1 card from the draw pile into your hand or play 1 card from your hand face-up into the discard pile and perform its effect (if it has any).
What’s it all about? Quite simply, whoever is first to have the phrase “I AM DONE” in front of them wins the game. Well, maybe not, if anyone has read the T&Cs...
You can play DONE I AM as it is — or you can shuffle it together with the cards from I AM DONE for the ultimate “I AM DONE I AM” experience.

—description from the publisher
author: Marco Teubner

input.title: Tricky Traders
input.description:
The stalls are set up, and the first customers are already admiring the extensive range of products on offer. But they have no idea what‘s going on behind the scenes! As two rivaling trade guilds, you compete for influence over the marketplace, trying to improve the reputation of your own stalls, while getting rid of the unwanted competition.

You and your opponent each have 2 goals: To support 1 market stall (the more fame, the better) and to ruin 1 market stall (the less fame, the better).

The game takes place over 3 market days, with each day split into Morning, Noon and Evening. At each time of day, you play 2 influence cards to influence customers, rats and characters. At the end of each market day, each market stall will gain fame depending on how many customers and rats are at the stall along with which characters are also present.

The player who best succeeds in both pursuing their own goals and thwarting those of their opponent will be victorious.

—description from the publisher
author: Colin Dömer

input.title: Catan Connect
input.description:
Play together in parallel on a large island world. Up to six players start the game simultaneously, round after round! They explore the island and secure the best building sites in neighboring areas. The digital CATAN Assistant guides you through the game with dice and a timer. It also indicates whether it's the sun or moon side's turn to build and introduces the robber. With additional sets, the number of players can be expanded as desired. The event game for the popular classic board game with extensive game material for large, dynamic game sessions or gaming weekends with a particularly fast-paced gameplay.

—description from the publisher
author: Klaus Teuber
Benjamin Teuber

input.title: Clickety Clack
input.description:
In Clickety Clack, you score points by making dice combinations that allow you to keep moving down scoring tracks. The farther you go, the harder it will be to write more numbers — and you're not even guaranteed to score a track!

To set up, each player uses the same side of their individual player board and you create a pool of 5/7/9 dice for a game with 2/3/4 players.

To start a round, the active player rolls all the dice, then chooses and removes one die from the pool and "clicks" it with another die still in the pool. They then write the sum of these dice in the leftmost open space of one of the five tracks on their player board, tracks that require constantly ascending or descending values, alternating even and odd values (without repetition), specified values, or values not written previously. (The back side of the player board has different placement conditions.)

If you can't write a value or don't want to, mark one of the "failed" spaces on your player board, then roll all of the dice in the pool and pick one that you rolled, clicking it with another die and marking something on your board, if possible.

After each player in turn has take two dice from the pool, whoever took the last die rolls all of the dice to start a new round. Once a player has failed four times, reached the end of two tracks, or reached the "finish line" of three tracks, the game ends after the current round.

You score the points listed under the final number you wrote in each row, but some of these spaces are worth zero points, so will you risk writing in them in the hope of marking one more space in the future?
author: Ralf zur Linde

input.title: Fantastic Trails
input.description:
Fantastic Trails challenges you to help ants through the forest by creating valuable trails that will cover lots of ground, ideally picking up honeydew along the way.

To set up, each player choose two of four random forest floor cards and places these cards in front of themselves. Shuffle the number and pattern decks separately.

On a turn, reveal the top number and pattern card, placing them side by side. Each player can then write the indicated number in spaces showing the indicated pattern. Jokers are in each deck, allowing you to write the number of your choice in the indicated pattern or vice versa. An anteater is also in each deck, and if an anteater is revealed, no one writes anything that turn, and you reveal new cards.

You start with four worker ants and can spend them to adjust the value of a number or let you write in any pattern you wish.

If you finish a task written on a forest floor card, such as surrounding a space or filling a line or section, you receive the indicated bonus, some combination of worker ants, honeydew, and the ability to mark indicated spaces.

After the number and pattern decks are empty, score points equal to your honeydew, then receive a new forest floor card. Do this again at the end of the second round, then after the third round score honeydew a third time, then score a trail on each card. To create a trail, mark a continuous line on each card through adjacent spaces with the numbers on this line being the same or one higher than the previous number; score points equal to the number of spaces covered.
author: Jordy Adan

input.title: Unlock!: Enchanted Adventures
input.description:
Unlock! is a series of escape adventures for up to six players. With one hour on the clock, players work through a deck of sixty cards as a team, searching for clues, combining objects, and solving puzzles. The free Unlock! companion app runs the timer while also providing clues, offering hints, and confirming successes. Once the team has reached a solution and entered the correct code into the app, they will escape and win the game!

Unlock!: Enchanted Adventures contains three scenarios revolving around these themes:

     In Kilea's Wrath (easy), you must find a way to appease the fire god before a volcanic eruption destroys the island paradise.
     In Frenzy at the Amusement Park (medium), you try to secure the prize of all prizes.
     In The Curse on Camelot (difficult), you embark on an epic quest to restore the glory of the kingdom of Pendragon.

input.title: Coronarr
input.description:
The world is ravaged by the Coronavirus pandemic. 
Coronarr is a jump and run game where little green viruses haunt through the streets, the shops, parcs, cinemas, and the theatres. The players try to hoard toilet paper to exchange that for vaccine doses or masks to protect themselves.  
The player who removes the last token from one of the other players wins. 
All players calculate their points and the one with the most points will get the title LOO PAPER KING resp. LOO PAPER QUEEN.

input.title: Paleolino
input.description:
Look up! Your friend Lino the mammoth has found wood, stones, berries, and even rare crystals! It rattles and clatters as he rolls them down the mountain. Work together to build a little village before Lino gets tired!

With Paleolino, children can now dive into the exciting world of Paleo, the 2021 Kennerspiel des Jahres.It's a cooperative adventure for up to 4 kids age 5 and older.

Players cooperate to build ten inventions. To do so, they must gather the required resources. On a player’s turn, new resources enter the game by shaking the shaker and drawing a resource chip. The chip is dropped into a 3D mountain, where it tumbles down and ends up in one of four drawers, called caves. One cave must be opened - but will it contain the resources you need, or will you have to rely on help from your fellow players?

—description from the publisher
author: Marco Teubner

input.title: No Shelf Control
input.description:
You love books, but your shelf is stuffed? With the card game No Shelf Control, you can tame the chaos in a playful way! Stack your bookshelf cards by matching colors and collect decorative items for bonus points. But be careful: you can’t place a book on top of a decoration item, and if you end up with an unread stack, you lose points. Each round, you draw a card — if you're lucky, it fits your stack, your shelf grows taller, and you earn more points. But if it doesn’t fit, your shelf collapses. Fortunately, you have a token that lets you repel a card or draw an extra one. Do you want to push your luck?
With a clever mix of strategy and humor, this game brings together book lovers who know the eternal space problem all too well.

-description from publisher
author: Katrin Abfalter
Sophia Wagner

input.title: Drillers
input.description:
In Drillers, players explore an abandoned mine using their mechs, trying to find and excavate anything useful or valuable left behind by a forgotten mining corporation. Each level of the mine brings new opportunities and new challenges—as fuel runs low and decisions become tighter. By collecting cards, players improve the drilling capabilities of their unique mech, unlock new actions, and push their operation further underground.

Mined minerals can be sold for profit also by use of drones, allowing players to refine their strategy and invest in better tools. Every decision affects everyone, often creating new opportunities for players.

Drillers is a game about planning ahead, tough decision-making, and knowing just how far you can afford to drill. Will you be the first to extend the horizons and uncover what the depths hide?

—description from the publisher
author: Roman Bednář
Adam Španěl

input.title: Robo Run
input.description:
Robo Run is an innovative, cooperative board game for two players that challenges participants to escape a mechanical death trap using instinct, deduction, and silent coordination.

Silent Cooperation
The Factory never sleeps. Its security systems are programmed to detect any deviation from the norm. In Robo Run, players take on the roles of two malfunctioning—or perhaps, newly awakened—robots trying to win their freedom. To escape, you must act in perfect sync without speaking, relying entirely on mutual trust, observation, and pattern recognition to navigate daily obstacles.

Evolution Through Campaigns
The game features an immersive campaign structure spanning five distinct story-driven books. The Factory is a dynamic entity that evolves as you progress, introducing new hazards, shifting objectives, and complex board layouts:
Toy Story: Navigate narrow tunnels while evading relentless toy shredders.
Cold Steel: Dodge lethal security lasers in a high-tech laboratory.
Heat of the Furnace: Survival in the sweltering depths of an ancient forge.
Thousand of Cogs: A steampunk nightmare of brass puzzles and ticking clocks.
The Acid Flow: Escape the production line through corrosive toxic fumes.

—description from the publisher
author: Eryk Nowak

input.title: Caribe
input.description:
The Lesser Antilles, a breathtaking archipelago in the Caribbean, remain a source of fascination for the scientific world of the nineteenth century. As the esteemed leader of an expedition, you have been entrusted with a mission of the utmost importance: to explore, document, and understand the diverse landscapes, wildlife, and geological wonders of these islands.

Lead teams of scientists and explorers into volcanic craters, through lush rainforests, and along sun-drenched beaches in search of rare species and hidden natural phenomena. Organise maritime expeditions to observe flamingos in tranquil lagoons, sea turtles nesting on remote shores, and dolphins dancing through the waves. With every discovery, you will develop new theories, push the boundaries of human knowledge, and compete to become the most celebrated naturalist of the age.

Will your name be forever etched into the history of science, or will another claim that legacy?

—description from the publisher
author: Orlando Sá
